commits.note: commits touching theOS/ from 31 October to the end of this session, the intents' threads included

summary: The theOS explainer (13 chapters with Architecture panels), the security audits and research that became the 91 current intents, then avenCEO: from a flow definition to aip-31df, built with its own steps. On 1 November each intent got its own Claude Code thread, with avenMAIA orchestrating: aip-31df built theOS's check (a crawl of every page state, green on 1,266 states); aip-6fb1 brought avenSANDBOX into theOS and ran the check inside its image; aip-836d gave brain its read verbs and moved every doc into brain/ under a flat hash id, shown by id and title; aip-59ad specified theOS's release and passed Gate A; aip-a195 was dropped. A clean cut was set (d-8912), then Samuel chose to finish aip-31df and aip-6fb1 in this session (d-93eb); aip-836d and aip-59ad stay parked.

asks.quote: Rename rule to policy; give read paths like every other operation; keep one single source of truth for the shape of operations; every reference names its data id at a version.
asks.did: The 13 chapters, their Architecture panels and the operations schema.

asks.quote: Run another deep security audit of everything decided so far: this is mission-critical crypto design.
asks.did: Audits from primary sources; findings became proposals.

asks.quote: Audit other systems in depth: Urbit and Tlon, Hypercore and Pears, Jazz's lenses, Loro's branching, p2panda and iroh.
asks.did: Research that fed the current intents.

asks.quote: One guardian per identity: its own primitive, the root of trust.
Let's build a proper flow pipeline instead: learn, propose, decide, on a kanban board.
Let's define from scratch how we actually want to work.
asks.did: The flow: first principles, design thinking, the Claude Code team, Shopify Helix, Harness², the Elephant-Goldfish Model.

asks.quote: Let's apply our own flow to building the flow engine itself, and call it avenCEO.
asks.did: aip-31df, three spec review rounds, five revisions.

asks.quote: We document everything there as our memory, each thing in its own doc.
asks.did: This: one JSON doc per thing in theOS/.

asks.quote: Each intent becomes its own Claude Code thread, and this session, avenMAIA, orchestrates between them.
asks.did: Five intent threads; avenMAIA records decisions, relays questions and merges their branches.

asks.quote: brain is the single source of truth: one folder, one door, every doc referenced by its hash and its title.
asks.did: aip-836d's checkpoint 1 and its migration: 332 docs under flat hash ids in brain/.

asks.quote: Start simpler: check the page layout states, one per view type; we can fine-tune later.
asks.did: theOS's check: every reachable state at phone and laptop size, buttons pressed once per view type, about a minute.

asks.quote: What is the biggest blocker now, and can we wrap it up?
asks.did: A clean cut: checkpoint 1 of aip-31df landed, the migration ran, every open intent parked.

corrections.text: The intent detail page broke: two parts of the page shared one CSS class name.
The scenario table squeezed its first column into a tall strip.
The intents and decisions pages did not scroll.
The board scrolled as a whole instead of per column.
Not every "rule" was renamed to "policy" after that was decided.
Slides kept an old shape of operations after its single source of truth changed.
The published page was not updated after a change.
Agents were modelled without their own identity, and coops with members.
An audit leaned on summaries instead of primary sources.
avenMAIA recorded "from production" as deploys started by hand (d-7994); Samuel had said in aip-59ad's thread that production starts them by itself (d-06a8).
avenMAIA read "a - no migrate them too" as keeping D-n and AIP-n as names (d-09f1); Samuel meant no numbers: reference by the hash and the title (d-4e7c).
